user.title: Set up Purolator
user.description: Purolator tracking needs no account or postal code — the hub is created right away. Add parcels afterwards via the integration options or the `purolator.track_parcel` service.

incoming_parcels.title: Manage incoming parcels
incoming_parcels.description: Tracking codes for parcels you are expecting. Purolator's tracking data cannot tell a parcel you sent from one you are receiving, so file each code in the list it belongs to.

outgoing_parcels.title: Manage outgoing parcels
outgoing_parcels.description: Tracking codes for parcels you sent. They are counted and reported separately, so they stay out of your incoming parcel count.

error.invalid_tracking_code: That does not look like a Purolator tracking code.

track_parcel.name: Track parcel
track_parcel.description: Start tracking a parcel by its Purolator tracking code.

direction.name: Direction
direction.description: Whether you are receiving this parcel or sending it. Purolator's tracking data cannot tell the two apart. Calling this again with the other direction moves an already tracked parcel.

untrack_parcel.name: Untrack parcel
untrack_parcel.description: Stop tracking a parcel by its Purolator tracking code.

tracking_code.name: Tracking code
tracking_code.description: The Purolator tracking code to stop tracking.

trigger_type.parcel_delivery_time_changed: A parcel's expected delivery time changed
